channel.title: Israel National News Flashes
channel.description: Latest news flashes from Israel National News

item.title: Haredi man attacked by 6 assailants in Borough Park
item.description: New York police were called to the scene following a report from Shomrim volunteers, arrested the suspects for questioning, and led them away from the scene in handcuffs.

item.title: Ben Gurion Airport: Baggage conveyors are back in operation, check-in counters have reopened
item.description: At Ben Gurion Airport, the baggage conveyors are back in operation, and the check-in counters have reopened.

item.title: After a week of searching, missing man found dead
item.description: The body of Katriel Nachman Keinan, 24, from Beit Shemesh, was found in difficult terrain in the area of the Switzerland Forest in Tiberias after more than a week of searches.

item.title: Amb. Huckabee: 'We have said to Hamas - your time is up'
item.description: The US ambassador to Israel defends direct talks with Hamas, saying Kushner delivered a blunt message: disarm, demilitarize and accept that they would need to leave Gaza.

item.title: Chilling: The words Yehuda Katz wrote
item.description: A summary of a Torah lesson written by Yehuda Katz in his youth takes on chilling significance.

item.title: The race against time: Firefighters race to rescue traped eagle owl
item.description: Firefighters race to rescue eagle owl trapped in bird net, racing against time and the risk of dehydration and deterioration.

item.title: When peace breeds complacency
item.description: The Torah's lesson is one Israel learned tragically on October 7: Do not mistake quiet for a permanent change in the intentions of those who wish us harm.

item.title: The favors of bad people
item.description: It is painful to note that, today, the degree of assimilation in the USA is such that, in the not distant future, the once robust American Jewish community will be a shell of its former self.

item.title: Netanyahu’s warning after Ben Gurion Airport chaos
item.description: The Prime Minister addressed the surprise strike and severe disruptions at Ben Gurion Airport and made clear that the airport would operate normally.

item.title: 'Supreme Court's hands will be full of blood'
item.description: Senior official warns Supreme Court justices they will bear responsibility if the funding crisis leads to disaster at crowded holy sites during Selichot and the High Holidays.

item.title: IDF reveals: Hamas uses Nasser Hospital to conduct brutal interrogations, torture
item.description: IDF intelligence reveals Hamas is allegedly using Nasser Hospital in Khan Yunis as an interrogation and torture center as the terrorist organization fears losing its grip over Gaza residents.

item.title: Protecting the home
item.description: Note: The parapet around the roof of a house protects the house. “You shall not place blood in your house": inside the house - inside the national home - must be a safe place.

item.title: A Wake-Up Call: Rethinking the Western Wall
item.description: Where is the real Western Wall?

item.title: All in the Family
item.description: Because of the closeness to his family, a person ometimes allows himself to speak ill of his wife, husband, children, uncles, and other relatives. This is an unfortunate error.

item.title: Chaos at Ben Gurion Airport as arrivals cease completely
item.description: Ground service workers halt passenger handling during the busiest travel period of the year, arrivals grind to complete stop.

item.title: 83-year-old sheikh with 45 children investigated for polygamy
item.description: Police suspect Rahat resident married 10 women over the years, including five non-Israeli residents, and harbored women staying in Israel illegally.

item.title: US Embassy delegation visits Upper Galilee to boost economic ties
item.description: US Embassy delegation visits Israel’s Upper Galilee to explore economic cooperation, investment, trade and regional development following the war.

item.title: Chaos at Ben Gurion Airport as check-in grinds to halt
item.description: Ground service workers halt passenger handling during the busiest travel period of the year, with nearly 100,000 passengers passing through the airport daily.

item.title: The Shofar's call
item.description: The Tur on the Laws of Rosh Hashanah wrote: "Therefore the Sages established that the shofar should be blown on the first day of Elul every year and all through the month..."

item.title: Police ask public for help finding missing Ramla man in Japan
item.description: Israel Police seek the public's help locating 23-year-old Amir Amberber of Ramla, who has been missing since arriving in Japan on August 2.

item.title: IDF drills for nightmare scenarios in Judea and Samaria
item.description: IDF troops simulate simultaneous attacks, mass-casualty incidents and threats to Israeli communities in major exercises focused on northern Samaria.

item.title: The ways of Tzaddikim
item.description: Man is a soul sent into the world to serve God. Therefore, all of his powers are necessarily enlisted in this plan.

item.title: Despite footage: Netanyahu denies that international forces entered Gaza
item.description: Prime Minister's Office denies authorizing the International Stabilization Force to enter Gaza and reiterates that reconstruction will not begin until Hamas fully disarms.

item.title: Tragedy at Soroka: Pregnant woman and unborn baby die
item.description: Woman in her 40s, 34 weeks pregnant, dies following a rare complication and sudden deterioration; hospital reports case to Health Ministry.

item.title: Watch: Yemeni forces attempt to shoot down Houthi drones on live TV
item.description: Al-Arabiya correspondent reports from front line of fighting between the government and Houthi terrorist rebels in eastern Yemen, as government forces fight off drones in the background.

item.title: Israelis to get visa-free entry to Colombia
item.description: Israel and Colombia scrap visa requirements beginning September 1, in the latest sign of rapidly warming ties between the two countries.

item.title: Report: Trump suggests intense attacks on Iran if economic pressure fails
item.description: Report: President Donald Trump has ordered his Iran negotiating team to freeze talks for several weeks as prospects for a deal with Tehran diminish.

item.title: Sa'ar hits back at UK: 'Israel will not be a passive victim'
item.description: Foreign Minister Gideon Sa'ar rejects Britain's criticism over E1, accusing London of 'one-sided' policy against Israel.

item.title: 'Settler arson' claim falls apart after police probe
item.description: Palestinian Arabs claim 'settlers' torched building with family inside, police investigators prove allegations utterly baseless.

item.title: Jerusalem’s Green Line brings transit revolution-with a catch for fans
item.description: Jerusalem’s Green Line begins service Friday, linking the city center to Malcha with 12 new stops, while a key stadium station stays closed during events.
